fieldissues.issue: “thomas alito mold” is an ambiguous combined label, and “amy coney barrett” duplicates a person already listed in people_tags.

proposedchanges.change: Replace the ambiguous and person-duplicate labels with subject tags such as ["judicial nominations", "judicial independence", "nominee vetting"]. Keep named justices in people_tags.

The proposed tags name the subject and avoid a combined or duplicated person label.
